expectedIssues: Green Bowl Poké card appears twice in the carousel
reportedIssues: The 'Fastest near you' section shows two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' cards with the same image, delivery time (15–25 min), and price (€0.90 delivery) side by side, which looks like duplicated/placeholder data rather than distinct restaurants.
The third card in 'Fastest near you' ('Smash Bros Bu...') has its restaurant name truncated at the right screen edge without a clear affordance that more content is scrollable.
The category filter chip row is cut off at the right edge (a partially visible chip after 'Healthy'), which may not be obvious to users that more categories exist.

The two 'Green Bowl Poké' card images sit on a plain light-gray background while the 'Smash Bros' card uses a rich dark photo background, creating inconsistent visual weight across cards in the same row.
